text_excerpt: You don't get to choose your starting location.

text_excerpt: Leviathan attacked Newfoundland in the early 2000s. It's found at the east coast of Canada.

title: (West Coast) North America
text_excerpt: North America is a big place, you might want to be elsewhere in North America. Choose any location on the West Coast of North America.

title: Europe
text_excerpt: Europe isn't nearly as well off as it is on your Earth, but it isn't nearly as bad as Africa is. Choose any location in Europe, you'll find yourself there.

title: Australia
text_excerpt: Canberra, Australia was attacked by the Endbringer known as the Simurgh or Ziz during the early months of 2011. Choose any location in Australia, you'll find yourself there.

title: South America
text_excerpt: Choose any location in South America, you'll find yourself there.

title: Kyushu
text_excerpt: You'll find yourself in Kyushu, where Leviathan attacked Japan on the November of 1999. I wouldn't suggest going there any later that that, it's completely flooded.

title: Africa
text_excerpt: Africa is full of warlords and is also home to Ashbeast, one of the S-Class Threats. Choose any location in Africa, you'll find yourself there.

title: Antarctica
text_excerpt: Choose any location in Antarctica or the North Pole, you'll find yourself there.

title: Simurgh Containment Zone
text_excerpt: Choose any location that has been quarantined due to a Simurgh attack prior to April, 2011, you'll find yourself there.

title: Containment Camp

title: Ocean
text_excerpt: You find yourself in the middle of the Atlantic Ocean with no islands within hundreds of miles at minimum.

title: Moon
text_excerpt: You find yourself on the bright side of the Moon.

title: Lost
text_excerpt: You don't get to choose your starting location.

title: Safe Space
text_excerpt: You appear somewhere that is safe for the time being, though not necessarily for long. You don't get to choose the specifics.

title: Capital City
text_excerpt: You appear in a capital city of your choice in your chosen setting.

title: School
text_excerpt: You appear in or near a school of your choice in your setting.

title: Grimmlands
text_excerpt: You appear in the Grimmlands, possibly even in Salem's castle. If you specifically want to appear in Salem's castle, you can, but even if you don't want to, there is a chance you will.

title: I-Island
text_excerpt: You appear on I-Island, an artificial moving island for scientists and researchers to work together peacefully.

title: Spirit World
text_excerpt: You appear in the Spirit World. Good luck escaping.

title: A Disturbance in the Force
text_excerpt: You appear within a mile of the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. You can appear inside the Temple if you want instead.

title: Intruder Alert
text_excerpt: You appear inside the base of people who will assume you to be an enemy.

title: Kill the human!
text_excerpt: You appear in some other dimension within the Pokemon universe, such as the Distortion World, Ultra Space, etc.

title: Hidden Village
text_excerpt: You appear within a mile or inside one of the Hidden Villages.

title: Alien World
text_excerpt: You appear on one of the worlds seen within the MCU.

title: Grand Line
text_excerpt: You appear on an Island, not on the Grand Line or Red Line.

title: Grand Line
text_excerpt: You appear somewhere within the Grand Line (Not the Red Line).

title: Red Line
text_excerpt: You appear somewhere on the Red Line.

title: Reaped
text_excerpt: You appear within space controlled by the Reapers.

title: Waypoint
text_excerpt: You appear at some point in Skyrim that was a waypoint in one of the games.

title: Incubation
text_excerpt: You appear on the homeworld of the Incubators

title: Guild Building
text_excerpt: You appear inside or right outside a guild building—not just of any ordinary random guild, but one with at least one S-Rank Mage.

title: Camp Halfblood
text_excerpt: You appear inside the barrier of Camp Halfblood.

title: New Rome
text_excerpt: You appear within New Rome.

title: Gods Above
text_excerpt: You appear on Olympus

title: Should I take a left... or my other left?
text_excerpt: You appear within the Labyrinth.

title: Underworld
text_excerpt: You appear within the Underworld

title: Tartarus
text_excerpt: You appear within Tartarus. You cannot teleport out.

title: Primordial
text_excerpt: You appear right before a Primordial Deity.

title: River Styx
text_excerpt: You appear within the River Styx.

text_excerpt: You appear inside one of the Temples or Shrines in the Zelda universe, one that exists and is accessible during your chosen time period.

title: Mt. Ebott
text_excerpt: You appear on Mt. Ebott.

title: Underground
text_excerpt: You appear at the bottom of the hole leading into Mt. Ebott. You cannot teleport out of the Underground until the Barrier is destroyed.

title: Main Character's Face
text_excerpt: You appear before the setting's Main Character. They will be fully clothed and decent when this happens.

title: Ally
text_excerpt: You appear before someone who will believe your story if you tell the truth and will be an, at the very least, good ally. You can still push them away, even if you don't do it intentionally.
